## Step 1 - Add a New Flow

1. Click **Create Blank Flow** button under the Flows section on the service dashboard. 

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/75a2d14-4.jpg",
        "Create Blank Flow.png",
        "Creating a Blank Flow using Services Dashboard"
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Creating a Blank Flow using Services Dashboard"
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


Alternatively, click **Flows ** tab (shown below), and then click either of the two **Create Flow** buttons.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/6be742d-5.jpeg",
        "Create Blank Flow - Under Flow Tab.png",
        "Creating a Blank Flow using Flows"
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Creating a Blank Flow using Flows"
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


2. Enter the Flow Name and choose the **Type **as WorkFlow. You can select 'Voice Flow' in case you want to build a voice flow.

3. In the **Method** dropdown, select the **New Flow** option.

4. Select **Start from Scratch** option to create a flow from the beginning and click on **Create **to proceed further. 

In case you would like to build an SMS survey, appointment reminder flow, or an autoresponder flow you can select one of the pre-built templates and get a head start.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/f0cf650-9.jpg",
        "Flow Templates.png",
        "Creating a Flow popup"
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "sizing": "400px",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Creating a Flow popup"
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


5. Once done, you will arrive at the **Select Trigger Category** page where you can configure how this flow will be triggered. You can pick from the displayed trigger categories e.g. channel triggers, system triggers, or custom triggers.

[block:image]
{
  "images": [
    {
      "image": [
        "https://files.readme.io/3e716c7-1.jpeg",
        "Flow Triggers.png",
        "Select Trigger Category window"
      ],
      "align": "center",
      "sizing": "500px",
      "border": true,
      "caption": "Select Trigger Category window"
    }
  ]
}
[/block]


From here on, you can follow one of the below end-to-end tutorials. 

- [Sending automated SMS using <<prodname>> Visual Flow Builder](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/sending-automated-sms-using-imiconnect-visual-flow-builder)
- [Setting up an Appointment Reminder in <<prodname>>](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/setting-up-an-appointment-reminder-in-imiconnect)
